name: SpatialScene
tagline: 在 iOS 15–18 上导入、下载并呈现具有空间层次的动态壁纸。
description: SpatialScene 让你通过 App 导入或在线下载空间壁纸，进行预览、管理并设为当前壁纸。
启用后，壁纸会随设备姿态呈现自然的空间层次与动态效果；深色壁纸可独立开关并通过 Apple 自适应暗化跟随系统外观。
你还可以独立使用锁屏时间功能；锁屏和桌面均使用系统原壁纸时，无需导入空间场景也能调整时间字体、手动填充颜色和不透明度。
iOS App 提供锁屏景深预览，可使用真实时钟与插件参数检查时间遮挡，无需更换当前壁纸。
features: 导入兼容的空间壁纸包
浏览带预览图的在线壁纸库
预览、管理并设置当前壁纸
iOS App 锁屏景深预览，支持“景深 / 无景深”对照和姿态联动，不会修改当前壁纸或插件设置
随设备姿态呈现空间层次效果
可按需启用主屏幕动态效果
支持实时切换“锁屏使用原壁纸”和“桌面使用原壁纸”，无需 Respring
锁屏与桌面均使用原壁纸时，无需导入空间场景也可独立调整时间字体、手动填充颜色和不透明度
锁屏使用原壁纸时自动停用景深和时钟自动取色
锁屏与桌面均使用原壁纸时停止壁纸渲染和姿态采样
旋转与转场期间提供静态回退，减少系统原壁纸露出
默认采用 Apple 自适应壁纸暗化，亮图多暗、暗图少暗并保持原有色彩比例
深色壁纸开关默认开启；关闭后保持壁纸原始亮度
0–100% 全局暗化强度，按比例调整每张壁纸已保存的暗化程度
深色开关与强度即时生效并保存，无需重新加载场景或桌面
统一锁屏、桌面与景深前景的暗化效果
暗化结果同步适配时钟自动取色
每张壁纸可独立保存深色强度
Mac Preview 支持深色/浅色预览与强度调整
可单独关闭锁屏时间外观修改，同时继续使用壁纸景深效果
无需 LiquidAss 即可调整锁屏时间字体大小、字重、字宽、字高与柔和度
根据当前壁纸自动匹配时间颜色，或手动选择颜色
时钟自动取色可与 LiquidAss 自适应颜色联动
实验性景深效果可让壁纸前景自然遮挡时间
保持锁屏时间、通知与正在播放控件正常显示和交互
可与 DynamicMusicBG 同时使用
usage: 安装后打开 SpatialScene App。
从在线壁纸库下载，或导入兼容的空间壁纸包。
预览壁纸并将喜欢的项目设为当前。
在 iOS App 中使用锁屏景深预览检查时间遮挡；首次使用前先锁屏并点亮屏幕采集数据，修改时间或插件相关设置后请重新采集。
预览使用真实时钟字形、位置、尺寸及插件参数，并可切换“景深 / 无景深”进行对照；此操作不会更换当前壁纸或修改插件设置。
在系统“设置”中启用 SpatialScene，并按需开启主屏幕动态效果。
如只需壁纸景深效果，可关闭“修改锁屏时间”以保留系统时间外观。
在时间设置中调整字体大小、字重、字宽、字高、柔和度与颜色；实验性景深效果可按需开启。
如需保留系统桌面壁纸，可开启“桌面使用原壁纸”，设置会立即生效。
如需保留系统锁屏壁纸，可开启“锁屏使用原壁纸”；此时景深与自动取色会停用。
锁屏和桌面均使用原壁纸时，无需导入空间场景，仍可调整时间字体、手动填充颜色和不透明度。
在壁纸设置中开启或关闭深色壁纸，并使用 0–100% 强度调节整体暗化；0% 保持原图，现有壁纸无需重新导入或转换。

changes: iOS App 新增锁屏景深预览，无需更换当前壁纸即可检查时间遮挡，并支持“景深 / 无景深”对照与姿态联动。
预览使用真实时钟字形、位置、尺寸及插件参数，并按设备屏幕比例呈现；首次使用先锁屏并点亮屏幕采集数据，修改相关设置后需重新采集。
预览不会修改当前壁纸或插件设置，并完善简体中文、繁体中文及英文提示。
新增“锁屏使用原壁纸”，可独立使用时间功能；锁屏和桌面都用原壁纸时无需导入空间场景。
原壁纸模式仍可调整时间字体、手动填充颜色和不透明度；锁屏原壁纸会停用景深与自动取色。
两边均使用原壁纸时停止壁纸渲染和姿态采样，并移除时间插件冲突提示、完善三语说明。
新增“启用深色壁纸”开关，默认开启并跟随系统外观；关闭后保留壁纸原始亮度。
新增 0–100% 全局暗化强度，按比例调整每张壁纸已保存的暗化效果，0% 保持原图。
开关与强度即时生效并保存，同时更新时钟取色与回退快照，无需重新加载场景或桌面。
默认采用 Apple 自适应壁纸暗化，跟随系统外观并根据壁纸亮度自动调整暗化程度。
统一锁屏、桌面与景深前景的暗化效果，并同步适配时钟取色。
兼容现有壁纸和深色强度设置，无需重新导入或转换。
新增独立的锁屏时间字体大小、字重、字宽、字高与柔和度调节，无需安装 LiquidAss。
修复景深遮罩、重复时间轮廓与异常裁剪，并增强时钟自动取色及 LiquidAss 联动。
优化设置顺序与开关联动，关闭时间修改后恢复系统字体和布局，并更新三语文本。
新增“修改锁屏时间”开关；关闭后保留系统时间外观，同时继续支持壁纸景深效果。
修复设置 Slider 无法实时生效或保存的问题，并更新英文、简体中文和繁体中文文本。
新增跟随系统 Light/Dark Mode 自动切换，并增强息屏切换与唤醒后的显示刷新。
新增 balanced-v1 色彩分级，压低高光、适度降低中间调并保留暗部细节。
新增每张壁纸独立深色强度，以及 Mac Preview 深色/浅色预览与调节。
新增旋转与转场静态回退，并支持实时切换“桌面使用原壁纸”。
新增 LiquidAss 自定义时钟冲突检测及明确的关闭指引。
重新设计设置页 Slider，修复重复覆盖冲突并完善三语文本。
新增 iOS 15–18 锁屏时间高度、粗细、颜色与不透明度调整，并支持自动匹配壁纸颜色。
新增实验性景深效果，可让 3D 壁纸前景自然遮挡时间。
修复 iOS 15 放大时间后的日期布局，并完善三语设置文本与实时生效体验。
修复锁屏壁纸可能遮挡时间、通知或正在播放控件并影响交互的问题。
修复通知中心下拉、停住与收回时壁纸不同步或残留的问题。
增强与 DynamicMusicBG 同时使用及插件禁用后的壁纸状态恢复稳定性。
修复插件关闭后，下拉锁屏或通知中心的壁纸图层仍可能保持透明的问题。
增强与其他壁纸插件同时安装时的图层状态恢复稳定性。
新增 iOS 15 支持，并恢复 App 网络与在线壁纸下载。
修复 iOS 16 上的兼容性问题与部分功能异常。
修复 RootHide 环境下在线壁纸下载失败的问题。
修复 iOS 16 上空间场景壁纸无法正常显示的问题。
新增在线壁纸库，可直接浏览预览并下载空间壁纸。
新增后台下载支持，离开 App 后仍可继续完成下载与安装。
增强下载校验、失败恢复及预览加载稳定性。

en.name: SpatialScene
en.tagline: Import, download, and enjoy layered spatial wallpapers on iOS 15–18.
description: SpatialScene lets you import or download spatial wallpapers in the app, preview and manage them, and set one as current.

Once enabled, wallpapers respond to device movement with natural layered depth effects. Dark wallpaper behavior can be toggled independently and uses Apple adaptive dimming to follow system appearance.

You can use Lock Screen clock customization independently. When both the Lock Screen and Home Screen use stock wallpapers, no spatial scene import is required to adjust clock fonts, manual fill color, or opacity.
The iOS app includes a Lock Screen depth preview that uses the actual clock and tweak settings to check overlap without changing the current wallpaper.
features: Import compatible spatial wallpaper packages
Browse an online wallpaper library with previews
Preview, manage, and set the current wallpaper
Lock Screen depth preview in the iOS app with Depth / No Depth comparison and motion response, without changing the current wallpaper or tweak settings
Motion-responsive layered depth effects
Optional Home Screen animation
Switch the Lock Screen or Home Screen to the stock wallpaper instantly without a Respring
Use clock font, manual fill color, and opacity controls without importing a spatial scene when both screens use stock wallpapers
Automatically disable depth and automatic clock coloring when using the stock Lock Screen wallpaper
Stop wallpaper rendering and motion sampling when both screens use stock wallpapers
Static fallback during rotations and transitions to reduce stock-wallpaper flashes
Apple adaptive wallpaper dimming by default, applying more dimming to bright images and less to dark images while preserving color balance
Dark Wallpaper toggle enabled by default; disabling it preserves the wallpaper's original brightness
Global 0–100% dimming intensity that scales each wallpaper's saved dark effect proportionally
Dark wallpaper controls apply and save immediately without reloading the scene or Home Screen
Unified dimming across the Lock Screen, Home Screen, and depth foreground
Clock color adaptation synchronized with the dimmed wallpaper result
Per-wallpaper dark intensity
Dark and Light previews with intensity control in Mac Preview
Disable Lock Screen clock appearance adjustments while keeping wallpaper depth effects
Adjust Lock Screen clock font size, weight, width, height, and softness without LiquidAss
Match the clock color to the current wallpaper automatically or choose one manually
Link automatic clock coloring with LiquidAss adaptive colors
Experimental depth effect that lets wallpaper foregrounds overlap the clock
Keep the clock, notifications, and Now Playing controls visible and interactive
Coexist with DynamicMusicBG
usage: Open the SpatialScene app after installation.
Download a wallpaper from the online library or import a compatible package.
Preview a wallpaper and set your preferred item as current.
Use Lock Screen Depth Preview in the iOS app to check clock overlap. Before the first preview, lock and wake the device to capture data; recapture after changing related clock or tweak settings.
The preview uses actual clock glyphs, position, size, and tweak settings, and can compare Depth and No Depth views without changing the current wallpaper or tweak settings.
Enable SpatialScene in the system Settings app and turn on Home Screen animation if desired.
Disable Modify Lock Screen Clock to preserve the system clock appearance while keeping wallpaper depth effects.
Use Clock settings to adjust font size, weight, width, height, softness, and color, and optionally enable the experimental depth effect.
Enable Use Stock Home Wallpaper to keep the system Home Screen wallpaper; the change applies immediately.
Enable Use Stock Lock Wallpaper to keep the system Lock Screen wallpaper; depth and automatic clock coloring are then disabled.
When both screens use stock wallpapers, no spatial scene import is required to adjust clock fonts, manual fill color, or opacity.
Enable or disable Dark Wallpaper and adjust global dimming from 0–100%; 0% keeps the original image, and existing wallpapers require no re-import or conversion.

changes: Added a Lock Screen depth preview to the iOS app, allowing clock-overlap checks without changing the current wallpaper, with Depth / No Depth comparison and motion response.
The preview uses actual clock glyphs, position, size, and tweak settings at the device screen ratio. Lock and wake the device once to capture data, and recapture after changing related settings.
The preview does not change the current wallpaper or tweak settings, and its Simplified Chinese, Traditional Chinese, and English guidance has been completed.
Added Use Stock Lock Wallpaper for independent clock features; no spatial scene import is required when both screens use stock wallpapers.
Stock wallpaper mode still supports clock font, manual fill color, and opacity controls; stock Lock Screen wallpaper disables depth and automatic coloring.
When both screens use stock wallpapers, wallpaper rendering and motion sampling stop; clock-plugin conflict guidance was removed and trilingual text was improved.
Added an Enable Dark Wallpaper toggle, enabled by default and following system appearance; disabling it preserves the wallpaper original brightness.
Added global 0–100% dimming intensity that proportionally scales each wallpaper saved dark effect; 0% keeps the original image.
The toggle and intensity apply and save immediately while updating clock colors and fallback snapshots, without reloading the scene or Home Screen.
Apple adaptive wallpaper dimming is now the default, following system appearance and adjusting intensity based on wallpaper brightness.
Unified dimming across the Lock Screen, Home Screen, and depth foreground, with matching clock color adaptation.
Existing wallpapers and dark-intensity settings remain compatible, with no re-import or conversion required.
Added independent Lock Screen clock font size, weight, width, height, and softness controls without requiring LiquidAss.
Fixed depth masking, duplicate clock outlines, and clipping, and improved automatic clock colors and LiquidAss integration.
Improved Settings order and toggle behavior, restored system fonts and layout when disabled, and updated trilingual text.
Added an option to disable Lock Screen clock appearance adjustments while keeping wallpaper depth effects enabled.
Fixed Settings sliders not applying or saving values, and updated English, Simplified Chinese, and Traditional Chinese text.
Added automatic system Light/Dark Mode switching with improved display refresh after appearance changes while the screen is off.
Added balanced-v1 color grading to reduce highlights and midtones while preserving shadow detail.
Added per-wallpaper dark intensity plus Dark/Light preview and intensity controls in Mac Preview.
Added static fallback during rotations and transitions, plus instant switching to the stock Home Screen wallpaper.
Added LiquidAss custom-clock conflict detection with clear disable guidance.
Redesigned Settings sliders, fixed duplicate overlay conflicts, and improved trilingual text.
Added Lock Screen clock height, weight, color, and opacity controls on iOS 15–18, including automatic wallpaper color matching.
Added an experimental depth effect that lets 3D wallpaper foregrounds naturally overlap the clock.
Fixed date layout after enlarging the clock on iOS 15 and improved trilingual Settings text and live updates.
Fixed the Lock Screen wallpaper covering or blocking the clock, notifications, or Now Playing controls.
Fixed wallpaper movement or residue issues while pulling down, holding, or dismissing Notification Center.
Improved coexistence with DynamicMusicBG and wallpaper-state restoration after disabling the tweak.
Fixed wallpaper layers remaining transparent in the Lock Screen or Notification Center after the tweak was disabled.
Improved layer-state restoration when used alongside other wallpaper tweaks.
Added iOS 15 support and restored app networking and online wallpaper downloads.
Fixed compatibility issues and feature failures on iOS 16.
Fixed online wallpaper download failures in RootHide environments.
Fixed an issue that prevented spatial wallpapers from displaying correctly on iOS 16.
Added an online wallpaper library with previews and direct downloads.
Added background downloads that can continue outside the app.
Improved download verification, failure recovery, and preview loading reliability.
